simple.meaning: properly, dripping ; hence, fresh (i.e. recently made such)

definitions.short: properly, dripping ; hence, fresh (i.e. recently made such)
definitions.full: H2961. tari [ טָרִי ] adjective fresh , only feminine singular טְרִיָּה fresh , טְרִיָּה לְחִיחֲֿמוֺר Judg 15:15 the fresh jawbone of an ass , i.e. not yet dry and brittle; ט ׳מַכָּה Isa 1:6 fresh, raw wound , not yield healed or even treated (so Ges Ew Brd Di Du; festering De Che).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root apparently meaning to be moist ;
